sanatci.title: Artıst
sanatci.body:
After his engineering education, he studied painting at the Hızır Tepeev Atelier and ceramics at the Meral Öztürk Atelier.

In his paintings and ceramic sculptures, he interprets ancient stories shaped between love, life and death, and the inner world of the human being, through a contemporary sensibility.

The collection The Silence of the Trojan Horse carries the story of the past into the present through the Trojan Horse, the immortal witness of Troy.
